export_policy.relative10_pilot5: one E4M3 source plus packed four-bit block offset0..9 choices and BN auxiliary state; derive lower exports only from saved source codes/scales/choices; no MX masters or FP32 theta in compact exports; resume retains theta and Adam
export_policy.independent_e2_pilot5: one E4M3 source plus one independent absolute E8M0 lower scale byte per group and BN auxiliary state; derive lower exports only from saved source codes and absolute lower scales; no MX masters or FP32 phi in compact exports; resume retains phi and Adam

fp32_decode_policy.independent_e2_pilot5: reject overflow; exponents126/127 are valid E8M0 but not all E2 element codes remain finite in FP32

mx_scale_policy.relative10_pilot5: unchanged E4M3 source scale floor(log2(amax))-8; both lower codes equal source E8M0 code plus per-block hard offset0..9; promoted integer addition; overflow rejected without clipping/wrap, including zero blocks
mx_scale_policy.independent_e2_pilot5: unchanged dynamic E4M3 source scale floor(log2(amax))-8; E2M3 and E2M1 share independent absolute E8M0 exponent round_half_up(phi); initialize once from initial E4 exponent+6, never recompute phi from E4; E8M0 finite exponents -127..127; reject nonfinite FP32 decode without clipping or wrap

purpose.relative10_pilot5: five complete train-only epochs: ten learned per-block lower scale factors1..512; unchanged E4M3 source and exponent/mantissa bit truncation
purpose.independent_e2_pilot5: five complete train-only pilot epochs from fresh weights; learn an independent absolute E8M0 scale shared by the E2 modes, initialized once to the initial E4 scale x64; unchanged E4 source and exponent/mantissa bit truncation

reporting_policy.relative10_pilot5: all three modes from same selected E4M3-best checkpoint; also all at last pilot epoch
reporting_policy.independent_e2_pilot5: all three modes at epoch5 or actual final epoch and at the same E4M3-best checkpoint; compare only matched epochs against historical five-epoch references; no epoch100 accuracy claim

source_cache_policy.relative10_pilot5: detached integer source, hard choices and derived codes; theta version fixed within triplet; cached q saved for backward; cleared before Adam
source_cache_policy.independent_e2_pilot5: detached integer source, absolute lower scale and derived codes; phi version fixed within triplet; cached q saved for backward; cleared before Adam

ste_policy.relative10_pilot5: identity wrt G(W) all three modes; theta gradient ln(2)*sum_real_block(grad_q*q) from E2M3/E2M1; no normalization; no direct E4 theta gradient; source codes/scales detached; retain G(W) derivatives
ste_policy.independent_e2_pilot5: identity wrt G(W) all three modes; phi gradient ln(2)*sum_real_block(grad_q*q) from E2M3/E2M1; no normalization; no direct E4 phi gradient; source codes/scales detached; retain G(W) derivatives
